release: Theme 1.32.1 (sitemap: leave out the noindex Composer page, the retired RTX article that answers 301, and posts whose canonical points elsewhere)
note: Theme only, on production 1.32.0 (release commit 112dd02, main 112dd02). Baseline: the 1.32.0 release manifest (291 files, sha256 b282a689...). Core stays 1.10.0. 3 files, all replaced: inc/learn-composer.php (the /learn/motion/compose/ page, already noindex, is left out of the Slim SEO sitemap), inc/seo.php (the retired old RTX article - post 1184, slug nvidia-rtx-spark-launch-announcement, which a Redirection rule answers with a 301 to /microsoft-nvidia-rtx-spark-local-ai-windows-2026/ while its Slim SEO canonical is empty and it is not noindex - is left out by its post type, ID and slug, fixed in code; a post whose Slim SEO canonical points to another URL is also left out; an empty or self canonical changes nothing), and style.css last (version 1.32.1, switch file). All use the existing slim_seo_sitemap_post_ignore filter (Slim SEO 4.9.11 on production). Only the sitemap changes: no canonical, robots, redirect or page output changes, no new rewrite rule and no database change. Expected on production: 594 sitemap URLs become 592 (the old RTX article in the post sitemap and /learn/motion/compose/ in the page sitemap); every other URL stays. The 1.32.1 build of af91dcc was never deployed (its plan expected the RTX canonical, which production no longer has); this release is rebuilt from its own release commit. Labs (Code Studio still a draft), Design Library (gate closed), Industry Hub, SVG Motion Studio and Learn stay byte-identical to 1.32.0.

B.check: Existing 101 URLs unchanged from the 1.32.0 state (/sitemap.xml and /learn/motion/compose/ included); /sitemap-post-type-post.xml loses exactly the old RTX article (post 1184, /nvidia-rtx-spark-launch-announcement/, which keeps answering 301 to /microsoft-nvidia-rtx-spark-local-ai-windows-2026/ through the Redirection rule; that article still answers 200) and /sitemap-post-type-page.xml exactly /learn/motion/compose/ (594 sitemap URLs become 592, none added, the other sitemaps keep their counts); /learn/motion/compose/ answers 200 with noindex, follow; an unknown URL answers 404; /labs/code-studio/ and /design/ still 404; style.css?ver=1.32.1; all 3 files match the manifest.

after_apply: Do not reset OPcache or purge caches unless separately approved: 1.31.0 to 1.32.0 showed new files are picked up without a reset. If a sitemap still lists the two URLs, recheck later; a sitemap cache purge needs separate approval.
after_rollback: No rewrite rule or database change to undo.

Check the 101 URLs match the 1.32.0 state, style.css?ver=1.32.0 and the sitemaps list the two URLs again (594); the old RTX article keeps its 301 (the Redirection rule is not part of the release). Cache purge and OPcache reset only with separate approval.
